title: Shape Shifter Reconciliation Configuration
description: A reconciliation specification or a catalog containing specifications.

EntityResolutionSet.description:
Entity resolution specification and mappings for a single target field within a project.
- `source` is the data used for entity resolution (either entity preview or custom query),
- `property_mappings` define how to map remote (OpenRefine) service properties to columns in `source`
- `remote` specifies the OpenRefine entity type and additional columns, and mapping contains the individual resolved items.

source.description: Data source: None (entity preview), entity name (string), or custom query (ReconciliationSource)
source.title: Source

property_mappings.description: Service property ID -> source column name mapping (e.g., {'latitude': 'lat', 'longitude': 'lon'})
property_mappings.title: Property Mappings

review_threshold.description: Score threshold for flagging review needed (default 70%)
review_threshold.title: Review Threshold
